# Robinson PrintWorks

> Robinson PrintWorks is a Rhode Island service-area 3D printing business run by Adam Robinson. It helps local customers turn photos, sketches, replacement parts, prototypes, tabletop models, gifts, and small-batch ideas into practical 3D prints.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://printworks.adamrobinson.tech/) — Services, process, gallery examples, quote request instructions, and frequently asked questions.
- [Gallery](https://printworks.adamrobinson.tech/#gallery) — Examples of replacement parts, mounts, models, gifts, fidgets, and functional prints.
- [Quote request](https://printworks.adamrobinson.tech/#quote) — Instructions for sending a photo, sketch, dimensions, material preference, quantity, and timing for free printability advice.

## Services
- Custom 3D printing in Rhode Island
- Replacement part printing
- Prototype printing
- Small-batch prints
- Gift and model printing
- Free printability review before quoting
- Local pickup by arrangement, with small shipped orders by request

## Materials and Inputs
- Common materials include PLA, PETG, and TPU.
- Project inputs can include STL, 3MF, OBJ, sketches, reference photos, links to existing models, or a rough idea with dimensions.

## Business Notes
- Service area: Rhode Island, especially Providence County and Kent County
- Business name: Robinson PrintWorks
- Website: https://printworks.adamrobinson.tech/
- Operator: Adam Robinson, https://adamrobinson.tech/
- First printability review: free
- Robinson PrintWorks will decline unsafe, restricted, or unsuitable projects and will recommend another process when 3D printing is not a good fit.
